rules.name: avoid-barrel-files
rules.description: Forbid authoring of barrel files.

rules.name: avoid-importing-barrel-files
rules.description: Forbid importing barrel files.

rules.name: avoid-namespace-import
rules.description: Forbid namespace imports.

rules.name: avoid-re-export-all
rules.description: Forbid re-exporting * from a module.

rules.name: consistent-type-specifier-style
rules.description: Enforce or ban the use of inline type-only markers for named imports.

rules.name: default
rules.description: Ensure a default export is present, given a default import.

rules.name: dynamic-import-chunkname
rules.description: Enforce a leading comment with the webpackChunkName for dynamic imports.

rules.name: export
rules.description: Forbid any invalid exports, i.e. re-export of the same name.

rules.name: exports-last
rules.description: Ensure all exports appear after other statements.

rules.name: extensions
rules.description: Ensure consistent use of file extension within the import path.

rules.name: first
rules.description: Ensure all imports appear before other statements.

rules.name: group-exports
rules.description: Prefer named exports to be grouped together in a single export declaration.

rules.name: imports-first
rules.description: Replaced by `import-x/first`.

rules.name: max-dependencies
rules.description: Enforce the maximum number of dependencies a module can have.

rules.name: named
rules.description: Ensure named imports correspond to a named export in the remote file.

rules.name: namespace
rules.description: Ensure imported namespaces contain dereferenced properties as they are dereferenced.

rules.name: newline-after-import
rules.description: Enforce a newline after import statements.

rules.name: no-absolute-path
rules.description: Forbid import of modules using absolute paths.

rules.name: no-amd
rules.description: Forbid AMD `require` and `define` calls.

rules.name: no-anonymous-default-export
rules.description: Forbid anonymous values as default exports.

rules.name: no-commonjs
rules.description: Forbid CommonJS `require` calls and `module.exports` or `exports.*`.

rules.name: no-cycle
rules.description: Forbid a module from importing a module with a dependency path back to itself.

rules.name: no-default-export
rules.description: Forbid default exports.

rules.name: no-deprecated
rules.description: Forbid imported names marked with `@deprecated` documentation tag.

rules.name: no-duplicates
rules.description: Forbid repeated import of the same module in multiple places.

rules.name: no-dynamic-require
rules.description: Forbid `require()` calls with expressions.

rules.name: no-empty-named-blocks
rules.description: Forbid empty named import blocks.

rules.name: no-extraneous-dependencies
rules.description: Forbid the use of extraneous packages.

rules.name: no-import-module-exports
rules.description: Forbid import statements with CommonJS module.exports.

rules.name: no-internal-modules
rules.description: Forbid importing the submodules of other modules.

rules.name: no-mutable-exports
rules.description: Forbid the use of mutable exports with `var` or `let`.

rules.name: no-named-as-default
rules.description: Forbid use of exported name as identifier of default export.

rules.name: no-named-as-default-member
rules.description: Forbid use of exported name as property of default export.

rules.name: no-named-default
rules.description: Forbid named default exports.

rules.name: no-named-export
rules.description: Forbid named exports.

rules.name: no-namespace
rules.description: Forbid namespace (a.k.a. "wildcard" `*`) imports.

rules.name: no-nodejs-modules
rules.description: Forbid Node.js builtin modules.

rules.name: no-relative-packages
rules.description: Forbid importing packages through relative paths.

rules.name: no-relative-parent-imports
rules.description: Forbid importing modules from parent directories.

rules.name: no-rename-default
rules.description: Forbid importing a default export by a different name.

rules.name: no-restricted-paths
rules.description: Enforce which files can be imported in a given folder.

rules.name: no-self-import
rules.description: Forbid a module from importing itself.

rules.name: no-unassigned-import
rules.description: Forbid unassigned imports.

rules.name: no-unresolved
rules.description: Ensure imports point to a file/module that can be resolved.

rules.name: no-unused-modules
rules.description: Forbid modules without exports, or exports without matching import in another module.

rules.name: no-useless-path-segments
rules.description: Forbid unnecessary path segments in import and require statements.

rules.name: no-webpack-loader-syntax
rules.description: Forbid webpack loader syntax in imports.

rules.name: order
rules.description: Enforce a convention in module import order.

rules.name: prefer-default-export
rules.description: Prefer a default export if module exports a single name or multiple names.

rules.name: prefer-namespace-import
rules.description: Enforce using namespace imports for specific modules, like `react`/`react-dom`, etc.

rules.name: unambiguous
rules.description: Forbid potentially ambiguous parse goal (`script` vs. `module`).
